name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: A donut chart in plain SVG that draws in slice by slice. The legend gives every share as text, and the total sits in the hole.

props.name: data
props.description: The slices in order, each with a label and a value. Values are shares of the total.

props.name: center
props.description: Content in the hole. Defaults to the total.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the legend with a percentage for each slice.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. A summary of the shares is added after it.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the ring to draw in.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
